basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old history enthusiast living in Manchester, UK. I recently developed an interest in amateur radio satellites, inspired by my love for technology and history. I work as a freelance web designer, which gives me the flexibility to explore new hobbies. My typical online hours are in the evening after 7 PM, as I spend most of my day juggling work and my newfound hobby. I'm single and enjoy spending my weekends experimenting with new technology, reading historical fiction, and catching up on the latest manhwa releases.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in History and have always been a self-learner, diving into various topics that pique my interest. My interest in AMSAT began after a friend introduced me to the concept of satellite communication. Since then, I've been voraciously reading up on amateur radio and experimenting with different setups to improve my skills.
